## *Generation Kill: Devil Dogs, Iceman, Captain America, and the New Face of American War* — Evan Wright

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The best forever-war memoir. Clean, almost unsettlingly detached narration. Gives a unique feel for the place and the texture of war, plus absurdities that are almost too much to believe.
